_note: Single source for every project page (/work/:slug). Read by the React app and by scripts/generate-route-shells.mjs. Only verifiable facts: dates are repo creation dates or role dates.

projects.name: The Home Club
projects.summary: A sports platform that turns memberships, programmes and community into one clear journey.
projects.description: A public-facing sports platform. Memberships, programmes and community activity live in one journey instead of three disconnected tools, so a visitor can go from browsing to joining without being bounced around.
highlights: Membership and programme flows in one product

projects.name: N8NHUB
projects.summary: Over 2,000 searchable n8n workflows, for people who want a working pattern rather than another tutorial.
projects.description: A searchable library of more than 2,000 n8n workflows. Each one is categorised and documented, so a builder can find a pattern that already works, read how it fits together, and adapt it instead of starting from a blank canvas.

projects.name: SpeedyInfluencer
projects.summary: Campaigns, creators and performance data in one focused workspace for brands.
projects.description: A SaaS workspace for creator campaigns. Brands manage campaigns, collaborate with creators and read performance data in one place, backed by custom APIs.
highlights: Performance data in the same surface

projects.name: SmartFurs
projects.summary: A storefront built around buyer confidence and a low-friction enquiry path.
projects.description: A modern storefront for puppy discovery. The structure is built around buyer confidence: clean navigation, clear listings and an enquiry path with as little friction as possible.

projects.name: WonderKit
projects.summary: A multi-tenant AI SaaS foundation with provider-swappable LLMs and durable agent runs.
projects.description: An agent-native SaaS foundation. LLM providers can be swapped without touching product code, agent runs are durable and resumable, memory lives in pgvector, and usage is metered for billing. Evaluation and deployment paths are part of the base, not an afterthought.

projects.name: Vigil
projects.summary: Security research tooling that makes security work part of the engineering record.
projects.description: A cybersecurity research tool. The aim is simple: security findings should live alongside the engineering work, so teams ship more complete products instead of treating security as a separate audit at the end.
highlights: Security as part of the engineering record

projects.name: NY Municipal Monitor
projects.summary: Watches 60 New York county sites for personnel and contact changes.
projects.description: A decision-maker monitoring system across 60 New York county sites. It imports an existing baseline, runs scheduled collection, detects personnel and contact changes, keeps the history, fires webhook alerts and gives operators a working dashboard.

projects.name: Maps Lead Engine
projects.summary: An async, resumable Playwright scraper that turns map listings into outreach datasets.
projects.description: Searches by city, area or geographic grid and turns map listings into qualified outreach datasets. It is async, resumable and crash-safe, so a long run picks up where it stopped, and exports to CSV and Excel.

projects.name: Mynecraft
projects.summary: A voxel engine written by hand, running in the browser.
projects.description: A hand-built voxel engine with procedural worlds, chunks streamed from web workers, custom lighting, AABB physics, mob AI, multiple dimensions and versioned saves. It runs on two runtime dependencies.

projects.name: Legal Intelligence
projects.summary: A local legal-document pipeline: Llama 3 fine-tuned with LoRA, with a second model checking every summary.
projects.description: A local pipeline for legal documents. It covers dataset preparation, Llama 3 fine-tuning with LoRA, PDF and DOCX processing, structured summaries and batch execution, with Gemma verifying each summary before it is trusted.

projects.name: Transcription Analyzer
projects.summary: Speech, OCR, NLP and sentiment, stitched into one pipeline.
projects.description: An early ML pipeline that combines speech transcription, OCR, NLP and sentiment analysis, with scraping to feed it real inputs.
highlights: Speech and OCR in one pipeline

projects.name: Anomaly Detection
projects.summary: ML ensembles running over streaming data.
projects.description: An anomaly detection system that runs ML ensembles over streaming analysis, flagging the records that do not behave like the rest.

projects.name: GPT-2 Generator
projects.summary: Local text generation with keyword extraction.
projects.description: Local text generation on GPT-2 with keyword extraction, built to understand how generation behaves without a hosted API in the way.

projects.name: witty-404
projects.summary: A Cloudflare Worker that writes a different excuse for every missing page.
projects.description: The API behind this site's 404 page. Ask it for a path that does not exist and it returns a joke, a fake diagnostic log and a footnote. Small, fast and served from the edge.
